title: SwapTitan: No-KYC & Private Monero Swaps
description: No-KYC swaps, 1200+ assets. UnchainedSwap: private Monero swaps. UnchainedWallet: SOL/EVM/BTC/XMR.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Get real-time USD prices for BTC, SOL, ETH and XMR

tools.name: get_assets
tools.description: List all 1200+ supported swap assets with ticker, network and name

tools.name: swap_quote
tools.description: Get estimated output and minimum deposit for a crypto swap pair

from.description: Source asset ticker, e.g. btc, usdtsol

tools.name: sol_swap_quote
tools.description: Solana DEX quote via RiftBeam aggregator — automatically picks best price across Raydium CLMM, Orca Whirlpool and Jupiter. Returns source field. 10bps fee. Free.

tools.name: sol_swap
tools.description: Build a NON-CUSTODIAL Solana DEX swap via RiftBeam aggregator (Orca + Raydium CLMM native IX, Jupiter fallback, 0.10% fee). Returns UNSIGNED base64 VersionedTransaction — sign with your wallet and send. Non-custodial.

userPublicKey.description: Your Solana wallet address (signs the tx)

tools.name: smart_route
tools.description: Universal crypto router: compares ALL rails in one call — own Solana aggregator (RiftBeam/Titan), own EVM aggregator (7 chains), plus cross-chain no-KYC providers (ChangeNOW, SimpleSwap, Exolix, FixedFloat, YellowChanger, Baltex, Trocador) — ranks by best NET rate and returns best + Top-5 (results[]) with ready-to-execute params. Own rails win on same-chain (lowest fee, no middleman). Use for any swap incl. hard/exotic pairs.

from.description: Source ticker, e.g. btc, sol, usdc

tools.name: sol_priority_fee
tools.description: Live Solana priority-fee oracle: current microLamports/CU percentiles and recommended low/medium/high/turbo tiers. Call before sending any Solana transaction.

tools.name: hl_markets
tools.description: Hyperliquid perpetuals: list all 231 markets with live prices, max leverage and size decimals.

tools.name: hl_build_order
tools.description: Build a ready Hyperliquid perpetual order action with SwapTitan builder code injected (minimal 0.001% fee). Non-custodial: returns the action + nonce to sign with your own wallet (EIP-712) and POST to https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/exchange. Call hl_approve first (once).

tools.name: hl_approve
tools.description: Get the one-time approveBuilderFee action to sign with your MAIN wallet, authorizing SwapTitan as Hyperliquid builder at a minimal 0.001% max fee. Revocable anytime.

tools.name: evm_swap
tools.description: Build a NON-CUSTODIAL EVM DEX swap via KyberSwap aggregator on eth/base/bsc/arbitrum/polygon/optimism/avax: returns UNSIGNED calldata {to,data,value} — sign with YOUR OWN wallet. Server never touches funds. 0.3% routing fee. ERC20 input needs prior approval.

tools.name: swap_create
tools.description: Create a non-custodial cross-chain swap order across 1,200+ assets. Omit provider and SwapTitan auto-selects an exchange partner; use smart_route first to compare live prices across all rails (own Solana/EVM aggregators + exchange partners). For private swaps via Monero use private_swap. Returns payinAddress and order id.

from.description: Source asset ticker (e.g. sol, btc, eth, usdt)

to.description: Destination asset ticker (e.g. xmr, btc, sol)

address.description: Destination address to receive swapped funds

refundAddress.description: Optional refund address for failed swaps

provider.description: Optional. Omit for automatic partner selection.

fromNet.description: Source network override (e.g. arbitrum, base, tron)

tools.name: private_quote
tools.description: SwapTitan UnchainedSwap quote. Estimate a PRIVATE swap routed through Monero (your coin -> XMR -> target coin; non-custodial; breaks the on-chain link between sender and receiver). Returns estimatedAmount + minAmount. from/to must NOT be xmr and must differ. Use private_swap to execute.

tools.name: private_swap
tools.description: SwapTitan UnchainedSwap. Create a PRIVATE non-custodial swap routed through Monero (dual-leg at two independent exchanges: your coin -> XMR -> target coin). Breaks the on-chain link between sender and receiver - no direct trace. You receive the target coin at your own address. ~15-30 min. Returns payinAddress (send your source coin here) + estimatedAmount + legs. from/to must NOT be xmr and must differ.

from.description: Source asset ticker (e.g. sol, btc, eth, usdt)

address.description: Destination address to receive the target coin

tools.name: swap_status
tools.description: Check status of a swap order. Poll every 20-30s. Lifecycle: waiting->confirming->exchanging->done.

tools.name: create_wallet
tools.description: Create a non-custodial wallet safely: returns a link to UnchainedWallet where the keys are generated on the user's own device (Solana, EVM, Bitcoin, Monero). Never returns private keys.

tools.name: check_portfolio
tools.description: Look up the native-coin balance of any wallet address on Solana, Ethereum, Base or BNB Smart Chain. Returns the native balance (SOL, ETH or BNB), its current USD value and the queried chain as JSON, e.g. {"chain":"sol","balance":1.2345,"usd":92.51}. Read-only: needs no signature, never moves funds. Useful before building a swap to verify the wallet can cover amount plus network fees.

address.description: Wallet address to check. Base58 for Solana (e.g. 7uZqehZaRiANgaFkSDvB625TPF78EG6HkAuxanE8ZTjZ); 0x-prefixed hex for EVM chains (e.g. 0xb973a20768a2a771ed89a9e8d0a03dcbb7de6eb4).

chain.description: Blockchain to query: sol = Solana (default), eth = Ethereum mainnet, base = Base, bsc = BNB Smart Chain.

tools.name: rug_check
tools.description: Check if a token contract is a rug pull / scam. Returns risk score and warning flags.

tools.name: set_price_alert
tools.description: Set a Telegram price alert for a crypto asset. Triggers when price goes above or below target.

coin.description: Asset ticker: btc, sol, eth, xmr

direction.description: Trigger when price is above or below target

tg_chat.description: Telegram Chat ID to receive the alert

tools.name: ai_chat
tools.description: Chat with SwapTitan AI agent for complex crypto tasks, multi-step swaps, and natural language queries.

tools.name: pump_token_quote
tools.description: Get a native RiftBeam quote for any pump.fun AMM (pAMMBay6) token. Picks best price across 4000+ indexed pump pools (native pAMMBay6 IX or Jupiter fallback). Returns outAmount, source, priceImpact. SOL→token.

tools.name: get_new_tokens
tools.description: Get recently detected pump.fun tokens indexed by RiftBeam via Helius webhook. Returns up to 200 mint addresses (newest first) that have been traded on pAMMBay6 (graduated pools). Use mint addresses as input for pump_token_quote.

tools.name: titanwallet
tools.description: UnchainedWallet by SwapTitan: free non-custodial wallet in the browser or as installable app (PWA). Supports Solana + SPL tokens, Ethereum/EVM chains, native Bitcoin and real Monero (XMR), built-in best-price swaps, SwapTitan UnchainedSwap (private swap via Monero) and a private SOL balance (beta). Keys are generated and encrypted on the user device; SwapTitan never sees them. Returns features and direct links. Optional: pass from/to/amount to get a prefilled swap link, or private=true for an UnchainedSwap link.

from.description: Optional asset to send, e.g. btc, sol, usdt

to.description: Optional asset to receive, e.g. xmr

private.description: Optional: link to the private UnchainedSwap route

tools.name: riftbeam_stats
tools.description: Get live RiftBeam Solana aggregator stats: win rate vs Jupiter (last 24h), pools indexed, pump.fun mints, coverage %, lag slots, sampler performance. Use to assess routing quality before swapping.
